What the Wolfpack Weekly is

The Wolfpack Weekly is Detachment 090's standing update. One issue goes out during the academic year with everything a cadet, family member, or friend needs to know: LLAB highlights, detachment events, and a spotlight on the people in the corps.

It exists so nobody has to piece the week together from four group chats. If it affects the corps, it goes in the issue. If you missed a week, the archive holds every issue from the current academic year and the ones before it.

What's in an issue

  • This week at a glance — dates, times, locations.
  • Uniform of the day — what to wear and when.
  • Physical training — the week's PT plan and meet time.
  • Leadership laboratory — the LLAB block and what to bring.
  • Deadlines and taskers — anything with a due date.
  • Recognition — cadet of the week and other wins.

Have an idea for an issue?

Let the Outreach team know what you'd like to see in an upcoming issue by emailing any of the addresses listed here. Photos are always welcome.
